643-4125-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-4125-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-5902-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Yoshimaru and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

512-1902-4644.easyPrerequisites: Wirewood Channeler and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-1902-4644.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
512-1902-4644.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Wirewood Channeler, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1902-4644.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Wirewood Channeler's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-2452-3249-4289--56.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2452-3249-4289--56.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the Zombie card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

650-4247-6553.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7159-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1414-2055-3430.description:
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {1}{W}, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Repeat.

856-3967-4321-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3967-4321-7422.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1339-2396-7307.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2396-7307.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Raphael, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-4871-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
2921-4871-5220-5946.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3750-5471-6898-7131.easyPrerequisites: Braid of Fire has an age counter on it, or Obeka's power is 3 or greater.
3750-5471-6898-7131.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Obeka. Obeka triggers, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this one.
Move to your first extra upkeep. At the beginning of that upkeep, Braid of Fire triggers, putting an age counter on it and adding {R} for each age counter on it.
Repeat step 2 for each other upkeep step.
During your postcombat main phase, activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-5471-6898-7131.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may kill Electro and use its triggered ability to deal infinite damage to target player.

2464-3459-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2464-3459-5078-6650.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-3459-5078-6650.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2034-6529-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

24-1330-1640.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Truefire Captain instead of you due to Pariah's Shield if you chose the largest number.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-1330-1640.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

2919-3330-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3330-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-4742-5315-5687.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Nahiri's Resolve, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

222-527-3480-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-3480-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

647-3259-3973-4050.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four permanents of any color on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control except Rith or Urabrask the Hidden.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-3973-4050.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1745-2842-3054-4647-4871.description:
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blood Artist trigger twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Blood Artist triggers, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Lord of the Forsaken ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast a spell from your graveyard.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

152-2441-3263.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Rasputin Dreamweaver with haste.
Put the oldest Rasputin Dreamweaver into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Rasputin Dreamweaver's first ability seven times by removing seven dream counters from it, adding {7}.
Repeat.

4050-4763-4766.notablePrerequisites: Deahrender attached to another nontoken creature you control.
4050-4763-4766.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Koll and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

1548-4034-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Yore-Tiller Nephilim does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
1548-4034-5147.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Port Razer from your graveyard onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with Port Razer and Yore-Tiller Nephilim.
Port Razer triggers, untapping each creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Port Razer, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

914-2534-3337.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2534-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Coercive Recruiter.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Reflection of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1769-2201-4816-4924.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1769-2201-4816-4924.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Infectious Host from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Infectious Host die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Infectious Host and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Infectious Host trigger, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 4.

738-1969-2034-5004.description:
Sacrifice Cathodion to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Cathodion and Grave Pact trigger.
Resolve Cathodion's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Grave Pact's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Cathodion to your hand.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
